integrity: The mathematical proof uses the classical Mantel theorem and a separate matching-deletion construction. Code and its exact output are embedded for reproduction. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple connected graphs with constant edge-girth 4; minimum possible order, not the full vertex-order spectrum. Finite computations test only the stated bounded parameter ranges; proof is universal. An unindexed equivalent result is possible.
title: Minimum order of graphs with constant edge-girth four
